questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select ‘No Error’.**

The Statue of Liberty is (1)/situated in (2)/New York City. (3)/No Error (4)
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 4**

There is no grammatical error in above given sentence.

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select ‘No Error’.**

Nita is not only (1)/my friend but (2)/business partner too. (3)/No Error (4)
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

Here, concept of conjunction is brought under consideration. There are certain conjunctions which come in fixed pair, as, so.....that, too....to, as long as, though....yet, **not only.....but also.**Thus, replace **too **with **also. **Hence, **option 3 **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **Nita is not only my friend but also business partner.

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be filled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

A stranger entered _____ room and closed all the window.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

Verb 'enter' means to go into. Thus, it does not take a preposition. Here, **option 3 i.e. the **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be filled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

A group of ABC School boys _______ the highest peak of Mt. K2.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

Clearly, the mountain peak is not lost. So, option 3 is eliminated.

Also, the mountain peak cannot be won since it is illogical. Thus, option 4 is incorrect.

Now, the verb 'walk' should come with a preposition here.

Thus, **option 2 i.e. scaled **which means 'covered with or made up of scales or overlapping plates resembling scales' is the appropriate answer.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which best expresses the meaning of the given word.**

Primitive
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

Here, word 'primitive' means relating to, denoting, or preserving the character of an early stage in the evolutionary or historical development of something.

Thus, word 'ancient' best defines the earlier time period. Hence, **option 2 i.e. ancient **is the appropriate answer.

Other words means today's time.

questions.question:

Here, word **annoy **gives the most opposite meaning to given word 'gratify'. Thus, **option 1 **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In the question below, a part of the sentence is underlined. Below are given alternatives to the underlined part which may improve the sentence. Choose the correct alternative. In case no improvement is needed, choose 'No improvement.'

It being a sunny day __we have decided__ not to go to the zoo but to go to a mall.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2 i.e We decided**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8c9521921258ec6abc07d0cc2f42f7e8a9f276861eb6ba131097c2c69c56057.png] ****Explanation**

**Looking at the sentence we find that**:

__
 
• The sentence here is given in the present tense. 
 
• The verb **go **agrees wit the tense. 
 
• In the given sentence the decision making does not happen in the past and continues to the present. Therefore** have decided** is incorrect. 
 
• Decided here is not a verb but an **adjective **as the verb here is **go**
 
• The sentence is not in the future hence will is incorrect. Also '**will'** takes the V1 form of the verb hence **Option 1 is incorrect.**
 
• **​**Hence the above point we find that **Option 2 ****We decided** is the only correct option that brings proper grammar to the sentence. 

The correct sentence will be: 'It being a sunny day** we decided **not to go to the zoo but to go to a mall.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

__
 
• उक्त वाक्य में, क्रिया **'go' **किसी विशेष काल के साथ मेल खाती है।
 
• यहां, निर्णय लेना अतीत में नहीं हुआ है और वर्तमान काल तक चलता है। इसलिए "**have decided" **गलत है।** "Decided"** यहां क्रिया नहीं है बल्कि विशेषण है।
 
• कृपया ध्यान दें, यहां की क्रिया** 'go'** है। वाक्य भविष्यवाची में नहीं है, इसलिए** "will" **अशुद्ध है।
 
• वैसे भी,** 'will' **क्रिया के **V1 **रूप को लेता है, इसलिए** विकल्प 1 **अशुद्ध है।
 
• यहां तक की उपरोक्त बिंदुओं के माध्यम से हमें पता चलता है कि केवल विकल्प 2 **"We decided" सही है, **जो वाक्य में उचित व्याकरण लाता है।

सही वाक्य इस प्रकार होगा:** "यह एक धूपीला दिन होने के चलते हमने निर्णय लिया कि हम चिड़ियाघर नहीं जाएंगे, बल्कि मॉल जाएंगे।"**

questions.question:
Directions: In the question below, a part of the sentence is underlined. Below are given alternatives to the underlined part which may improve the sentence. Choose the correct alternative. In case no improvement is needed, choose 'No improvement.'

__I am trying__ to make her eat since morning but she is not eating at all.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**I have been trying"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

**Looking at the given sentence we find that**:

 
• **Since morning** and **not eating** conveys that the **action happened sometime in the past and is continuing in the present. **
 
• Thus it is clear that the tense of the sentence is **Present Perfect Continuous. **
 
• **Option 1 **is the only correct option here as it is in the Present Perfect Continuous form. 

Hence the only option that can give proper meaning to the sentence is **Option 1 **and therefore the correct answer. 

**The correct sentence will be:*** '**I have been trying** to make her eat since morning but she is not eating at all.'*

questions.solution:

Gulf - a deep inlet of the sea almost surrounded by land, with a narrow mouth.

Peninsula - a piece of land almost surrounded by water or projecting out into a body of water.

Here, **option 3 i.e. archipelago **is the appropriate answer.

questions.question:
**The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

The recession has made

P: but because of limits to growth

Q: because of limits to growth

R: us realize that it is not
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

Clearly, a sentence does not end with 'not'. It only ends in case of question tag type of sentences. Thus, options 3 & 4 are incorrect. In option 2, sequence QR is incorrect because 'growth' is a noun and 'us' is a pronoun, they do not come together. Hence, **option 1 i.e. RQP **is the appropriate answer.

questions.question:
**The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

Floods in many parts

P: states of Bihar and Assam

Q: of India like the

R: are a yearly phenomenon
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

Since, the starter ends with noun, so it cannot start with a noun again. Thus, option 1 is eliminated. Also, articles are used to define noun. Hence, they come before either noun or adjective. Thus, sequence QR in option 3 is incorrect. Now, option 4 does not make a meaningful sentence. Hence, **option 2 i.e. QPR **is the appropriate answer.

questions.question: Corruption is also called ________ in India.

questions.question: ________ Investor confidence and stops economic growth of the business
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

Let's find out meaning of following words :- 

Enhances - intensify, increase, or further improve the quality, value, or extent of.

Damages - to harm.

Shocks - a sudden upsetting or surprising event or experience.

Exfoliates - a material to be shed from a surface in scales or layers.

The context explains that this disease of corruption increases risks and costs to business. So, clearly it does not improve investor's confidence. Thus, option 1 is incorrect. Option 4 is out of context. And **option 2 i.e. damages **is more appropriate because corruption damages business and stops business growth.

questions.question: In a row of 40 trees, lemon tree is 23rd from the right end. What is its position from left end?
questions.solution:
Position of lemon’s tree from the left end is = (total no. of trees in the row – position of the tree from the right end) + 1

Left end = (40 – 23) + 1

Left end = 18

Clearly, lemon’s tree position from the left end is 18th.

questions.question: In a certain code language, "FROG" is written as "IURJ". How is "JUMP" written in that code language?
questions.solution:
The logic here is as follows,

F + 3 = I

R + 3 = U

O + 3 = R

G + 3 = J

Similarly,

J + 3 = M

U + 3 = X

M + 3 = P

P + 3 = S

Thus JUMP is coded as MXPS.

questions.question: In a certain code language, "CALL" is written as "84" and "ROAM" is written as "141". How is "HANG" written in that code language?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is,

CALL → (3 + 1 + 12 + 12) × 3 = 84

ROAM → (18 + 15 + 1 + 13) × 3 = 141

Similarly,

HANG → (8 + 1 + 14 + 7) × 3 = **90**

Hence, HANG is coded as 90.

questions.question: How many positive factors of 120 are there?
questions.solution:
The factors of 120 are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20, 24, 30, 40, 60, 120.

Hence, there are 16 positive factors of 120.

Hence, The correct answer is option 2.

__**Smart method**__

120 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 5 = 2³ × 3¹ × 5¹

Hence, number of positive factors = (3 + 1)(1 + 1)(1 + 1) = 4 × 2 × 2 = 16

Digit 2 in 21 to 30 → 10 times (21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29)

Digit 2 in 31 to 40 → 1 times (32)

Digit 2 in 41 to 50 → 1 times (42)

Digit 2 in 51 to 60 → 1 times (52)

Digit 2 in 61 to 70 → 1 times (62)

Digit 2 in 71 to 80 → 1 times (72)

Digit 2 in 81 to 90 → 1 times (82)

Digit 2 in 91 to 100 → 1 times (92)

Digit 2 appears 20 times in first 100 natural numbers.

questions.question: A and B can complete a work in 40 days, B and C in 60 days and A and C in 48 days. Who is the most efficient worker among A, B and C?
questions.solution:
Given, 

(A + B) complete a work in 40 days.

⇒ (A + B)’s one day work = 1/40

(B + C) complete a work in 60 days.

⇒ (B + C)’s one day work = 1/60

(A + c) complete a work in 48 days.

⇒ (A + c)’s one day work = 1/48

They together can do the work in, 

⇒ (A + B + B + C + A + C) = 1/40 + 1/60 + 1/48 = (6 + 4 + 5)/240 = 15/240

⇒ 2(A + B + C) = 1/16

⇒ (A + B + C) = 1/32

Now, A, B and C can do the work separately in, 

⇒ A = (A + B + C) - (B + C) = 1/32 - 1/60 = (15 - 8)/480 = 7/480 

A can do the whole work = 480/7 ≈ 69 days

⇒ C = (A + B + C) - (A + B) = 1/32 - 1/40 = (5 - 4)/160 = 1/160

C can do the whole work = 160 days

⇒ B = (A + B + C) - (A + C) = 1/32 - 1/48 = (3 - 2)/96 = 1/96

C can do the whole work in 96 days

Hence, A is more efficient than B and C, because he can complete the whole work in less time than B and C.

(A + B) can complete the whole work in 4 hours

questions.question: If the radius of sphere is reduced by 10% then what will be the percentage change in its total surface area?
questions.solution:

If the radius of sphere is reduced by 10%,

Percentage change = frac{{4pi {r²} - 4pi ( {0.81} ){r²}}}{{4pi {r²}}} times 100

 = frac{{1 - 0.81}}{1} times 100 = 19 \%

questions.question: Marked price of an article is Rs. 3500. It was sold at a discount of 14.28%. If there was a loss of 20%, then what was the cost price (in Rs) of the article?
questions.solution:
**Short trick∶**

∵ 14.28% = 1/7

Required cost price = 3500 × 6/7 × 1/0.8 = Rs. 3750

**Detailed solution∶**

MP of an article = 3500

Discount = 14.28% = 1/7

Then, SP of an article = 3500 - 3500 × 1/7 = 3000

We know that, 

SP = CP + CP × Loss%/100

⇒ SP = CP + CP × 20%/100

⇒ SP = 80CP/100

⇒ CP = (100 × 3000) × 80 = Rs. 3750

Discount% = 15%

⇒ SP = 2550

Now, 

Profit = SP - CP = 2550 - 2500 = 50

⇒ (A + B + C) = 59

questions.question: A certain amount is invested in a scheme of simple interest. It amounts to Rs. 3600 in 5 years and Rs 4560 in 8 years. What is the rate of interest (in percentage)?
questions.solution:
Amount at the end of 5 years = 3600

Amount at the end of 8 years = 4560

∵ SI is same for every year

Increase in SI = 4560 - 3600 = 960

The simple interest for 3 years = 960

The simple interest for 1 year = 960/3 = 320

Simple interest for 5 year = 320 × 5 = 1600

Principal = 3600 - 1600 = 2000

We know that, 

SI = (PRT)/100

R% = SI × 100/PT

R% = (320 × 100)/2000 = 16%
